name: Barba's Painting & Services
address: 272 W 34th St, Hialeah, FL 33012, United States

reviews.author: Mara Roque
reviews.text: Highly recommend! They did an incredible job painting my backyard fence and the outside of my house. The work was clean, professional, and finished on time. You can tell they really care about the quality of their work. My house looks brand new! I will definitely be using them again for future projects.

reviews.author: Lazaro Betancourt
reviews.text: If you're looking for quality work, go with Barbs Painting. Danny did an incredible job and ensured everything was done right from the first day to the last. My house looks amazing, and I'm beyond happy with the results. Great experience all around!

reviews.author: Evan Stone
reviews.text: Danny is extremely professional and detail oriented. He has done two jobs for me on my home and the work was beautiful! He is very reliable and always does what he says he's going to do. I would highly recommend his painting company.

reviews.author: Tai Quinones
reviews.text: Danny's team was very reliable, friendly & efficient. They painted room we turned into a library and had built in bookshelves. They did a wonderful job! They also painted our rail. We are really happy with their service!

reviews.author: Acacia Regalado
reviews.text: We had a great experience with this painting company! They repaired drywall inside our home and painted the exterior, and everything came out beautiful. The team was professional, on time, and very careful with their work.
